_doc: PART 7a (18 Nov): every reason string public/ops/checks.json may carry, and who acts on it. Owners: "editing team" (fix links, sharing, cuts in the master sheet / Drive), "reviewer" (listen or watch, then approve anyway / hold / fixed), "Learn-PE" (Learn pipeline: conversion, playback, exceptions). checks.json may use ONLY these reasons: scripts/master/checks.mjs refuses any other, and a test checks the committed checks.json. Descriptions for Operations: public/ops/check-reasons.json.
